name: Raya Restaurant
tagline: A century-old mansion serving classic Phuket cuisine
taglineZh: 百年老宅里的经典普吉菜
description: Housed in a beautifully preserved Sino-Portuguese mansion in Phuket Town, Raya is the definitive address for authentic Phuket cuisine. Signature dishes include crab curry with morning glory, southern-style spicy salads and the famous braised pork belly.
descriptionZh: Raya 位于普吉镇一栋保存完好的中葡风格百年老宅内，是品尝地道普吉菜的首选。招牌菜有咖喱炒蟹配空心菜、泰南酸辣沙拉与著名的卤猪肘。

location.address: 9 Phoon Phol Rd, Talat Nuea, Mueang Phuket 83000

name: One Chun Restaurant
tagline: Michelin Guide southern Thai cooking in Old Town
taglineZh: 普吉老城区的米其林指南泰南菜
description: One Chun serves refined southern Thai food in a restored shophouse in Phuket Old Town. Listed in the Michelin Guide, it is celebrated for its crab meat curry stir-fry, charcoal-grilled dishes and homestyle southern curries.
descriptionZh: One Chun 位于普吉老城一栋翻新骑楼内，入选米其林指南，主打精致泰南菜。蟹肉咖喱炒蟹、炭火烧烤与家常泰南咖喱广受好评。

location.address: 48/1 Thepkrasattri Rd, Talat Nuea, Mueang Phuket 83000

name: Laem Hin Seafood
tagline: Local seafood pier famous for mok bali crab
taglineZh: 本地人喜爱的海鲜码头，招牌椰叶蒸蟹
description: Perched on a pier in the east of the island, Laem Hin Seafood is where Phuket locals go for fresh seafood at honest prices. The must-try dish is 'mok bali' — crab steamed in banana leaf with curry paste — alongside grilled fish and tom yum.
descriptionZh: Laem Hin 位于普吉岛东海岸的码头上，是本地人吃平价新鲜海鲜的首选。必点招牌「Mok Bali」——咖喱酱配蟹肉以香蕉叶包裹清蒸，另有炭烤鱼与冬阴功。

services.name: Mok Bali (Steamed Crab in Banana Leaf)
